The espionage system is complete and undercover cells have penetrated into the organization. A mistake in the red team's rape spree triggered a chain of disasters, and the operations department was almost wiped out. The costs of armed resistance have become unbearable. But the underground struggle did not die there. Some people live in seclusion in private houses, guarding tens of thousands of early Party archives as their lives, even if they are cut off, hungry, or seriously ill; some people travel through the streets and markets, looking for missing children among hundreds of thousands of homeless people. The roar of swords and guns gradually dissipated, while another kind of struggle, in the form of silence, struggled hard among the Shikumen and streets of Shanghai. The smoke of gunfire fades and the shouts return to silence. True faith may not always be heard by the sound of gunshots, but more of the silent burden and perseverance in desperate situations. en.title: Firaxis faces restructuring: about 60 employees laid off, chief executive leaving
en.summary: On November 18th, Beijing time, Firaxis Games, the studio that developed “Civilization” and “XCOM”, announced layoffs. According to foreign media reports, about 60 people will be laid off this time, equivalent to one-third of the studio's employees. Take-Two's publishing brand 2K also confirmed that Firaxis is reorganizing and that studio head Heather Hazen will also leave. A 2K spokesperson also revealed that Firaxis will reduce the size of its team during the reorganization, and its future focus will still be on the design, technology and player experience of strategy games. When it comes to the part of the person in charge, Hazen, 2K said that Hazen believes that it is appropriate to take over now to ensure that the next person in charge can fully lead the reorganized team. Heather Hazen joined Firaxis in 2020. Previously, she worked at PopCap and Epic Games.

items.summary: 为迎接《GTA6》的发售，索尼互动娱乐再度为 PS5 推送了版本更新。据悉，本次更新为强制安装，所有玩家需升级固件方可游玩《GTA6》。官方建议玩家在11月19日午夜前下载并安装更新，确保《GTA6》解锁后就能立刻畅玩。 随着 AI 的浪潮，逆向主机也越发容易。此前，有知名黑客表明自己成功在此前的14.22固件中提取了游戏文件，因此索尼本次的14.23固件很可能是为了防止越狱主机首日盗版的最新尝试。R星母公司此前也表示，会全力打击 AI 逆向等侵犯知识产权的乱象。

en.title: "GTA6" is about to be released, Sony once again pushes firmware upgrade
en.summary: In preparation for the release of "GTA6", Sony Interactive Entertainment has once again pushed a version update for PS5. It is reported that this update is a mandatory installation, and all players need to upgrade the firmware before playing "GTA6". Officials recommend that players download and install the update before midnight on November 19th to ensure that "GTA6" can be played immediately after being unlocked. With the wave of AI, it is becoming easier to reverse the host. Previously, a well-known hacker stated that he successfully extracted game files from the previous 14.22 firmware. Therefore, Sony's 14.23 firmware is likely to be Sony's latest attempt to prevent first-day piracy of jailbroken consoles. Rockstar’s parent company has also previously stated that it will make every effort to combat chaos such as AI reverse engineering and other infringements of intellectual property rights.

Death fans who accept all the ups and downs, what do they really want? It's nice to still have the opportunity to discuss these issues, even though I don't know if a conclusion will be reached or when the next time Death will be the subject of our show. en.title: After the game became popular, there was only one week left before it was copied by AI
en.summary: ■ An idea that may be stolen once it is released. "Emerald Scratch" (formerly known as "Stone Gambling Scratch") has become popular, but Insomniac Game Studio's Pen Pen is not happy. "You have about a week's window period." The mobile publisher who contacted them reminded them that in a week, there will be pirated copies of this game everywhere on the market. Peipeng knows that this statement is correct. "Emerald Scratch" is an entry submitted by the team when participating in an independent game exhibition. On May 16, 2026, the game released a demo on the event platform. Within three or four days, many anchors started live streaming the game. Penpeng also posted a post to celebrate: "Our game is popular!" The celebration was short-lived. This is where things started to turn bad. As the publisher said, a week later, a large number of small games with exactly the same core gameplay as "Emerald Scratch" appeared on Douyin and other platforms. The graphics of these games are similar to those of "Emerald Scratch".

en.title: Conversation with practitioners in Japan: Why does Tencent’s “Monster Hunting” mobile game top the best-selling list in Japan?
en.summary: On October 29, the international server of "Monster Hunter: Traveler", developed by Tencent Tianmei and Capcom, was launched overseas. Subsequently, the game successively reached the top in markets such as Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. Among them, Japan has become the region with the highest overseas revenue for “Monster Hunter: Traveler”. Since its launch half a month ago, "Monster Hunter: Traveler" has remained in the top 5 best-selling iOS games in Japan. On the iOS side, in Europe, America and Japan, the revenue in Japan exceeds 60% (sourced from Diandian data). Some practitioners attribute this to IP influence and purchase volume. However, according to the international version of AppGrowing, the amount of material released for this game in Japan is not high. Chule asked project members. Some people think it has basically met expectations, but others are surprised that the game has reached the top of the best-selling game list in Japan. In the end, their conclusion was that “Japanese players like to draw cards” and “Japanese mobile games are too sexy.”
